scope: opc-relationships internal graph foundation; no public API or complete parity claim

accounting.other_cases: All other unit variants and BDD examples remain in the complete test-case-map.json ledger; no status is promoted by dependency on this graph layer.

selection: All relationship classes/members and package part traversal in tests/opc/test_package.py, relationship XML classes in tests/opc/test_oxml.py, and the explicit external-relationship BDD round-trip scenario. Higher-level slide, hyperlink, image, notes and chart scenarios retain their existing feature assignments and are not claimed as passes here.

language_security.owner_ids: IDs are exact source-local strings, never globally keyed.
language_security.external: Raw targets retained, no URL fetching or ambient capabilities; internal targetPart is null for external edges. Public throwing accessors remain deferred.
language_security.collections: Immutable internal arrays and Maps, distinct from future live public model collections.
language_security.limits: Explicit part, total relationship and XML byte bounds; synchronous internal indexing/traversal.
language_security.imports: New immutable graph plus deterministic name mapping. No payload copy, XML serialization or public slide merge.
language_security.public_api: Existing complete API inventory remains authoritative including all inherited, underscore-prefixed, enum/helper and untested members. No public member is reclassified as private.

documentation_drift: Historical audit statements that adaptation has not started do not describe the later package implementation. This dated supplement and earlier package evidence establish only their explicitly tested subsets; baseline inventories are preserved.
legal: Original TypeScript implementation, assertions, wording and assets; no source text or reference fixtures copied. Reference identities remain in this provenance record and existing standalone legal notices.
